title: LT8584 active cell balancer
notes: Native 4.2 V cell and 50 V pack source retained.
Original saved LTspice log has no stop/error marker; its raw data is included as historical simulation evidence.

title: LTC3300-1 six-cell bidirectional balancer
notes: Six 3.6 V cell sources and 43.2 V stack supply retained.
Vendor default commands are 0,1,2,3,0,1 for cells 1..6; this is not a full BMS or SOC controller.
Serial interface, watchdog and single-transformer behavior are not represented by this model, as stated in the original schematic.

title: LT8304 isolated dual-secondary flyback
notes: Uses Draft1.asc, whose saved log completed, rather than the interrupted DC2393A or floating-driver variants.
48 V input, 20 uH primary, 11 uH and 1.2 uH secondaries and 200 ohm output loads are retained.
Output labels were added at the actual capacitor pins; rail voltages are not asserted from the filename.

title: LTC7851 four-phase VRM load transient
notes: 12 V input and the existing four-phase power stage retained.
Removed the separate Iload Vout 0 directive; the connected I1 source still steps from 10 A to 100 A.
Replaced ambiguous capacitor multiplier X15 with an explicit 1500u value.
Measurement windows exclude startup; native LTspice rerun remains required.

title: 12-bit sample-and-hold / quantizer model
notes: Behavioral acquisition and quantization model; no SAR register, comparator bit trial, or real ADC device is modeled.
Separated the clock from SH_OUT and joined the switch output to the hold capacitor.
Changed hold capacitor to 100p and leakage load to 1T; codes are clipped to 0..4095.
The original .four result is not a valid ENOB result; it is retained only in source evidence.
